summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, string-object indirection) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then uses that freshly downloaded runtime to execute the sibling `math_init.js` (727KB, obfuscator.io-style string-array-shuffle obfuscation, tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`) via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D,'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. The package's advertised purpose is a React Native mobile library, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time. Executing the payload through Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-based inspection tooling, and both the loader and the payload are heavily obfuscated to conceal behavior from static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
